response.reason: The cited clause from Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 Art. 7(3) explicitly prohibits attributing to a food any properties of preventing, treating, or curing a human disease, or creating the impression of such properties. The verdict concerns a claim that 'Calcium makes your bones unbreakable,' which implies a disease-preventing property. The clause directly establishes the prohibition that the verdict turns on, so the citation is appropriate and supports the verdict.
